name: Neelam Linens and Garments (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in September 2010, Neelam Linens and Garments (India) Ltd is a soft home furnishing company. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Divison
1. Processing and Trading of Products (60.6% of the revenue)[1]
Home Furnishing Products: This is their primary business division, focused on design, processing, and supply of various soft home furnishing items.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend

Company has high debtors of 154 days.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
